items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: and Joe Marsala, he gave Zutty some money and told Zutty he wanted him to play the jam session on Sunday afternoon.

ctx.x: Oh that was a good friend.

I'm telling you. He really looked out for us. But we were as happy as, we weren't worried at all. We were just as happy as we could be. We were in New York, we made it. And we were happy. And the next day Zutty contacted (Mezz?) and let him know we were in town. And (Mezz?) was right up there. And on the Monday night (Mezz?) took us down to the (Hickory) House for sizzling steaks because Joe Marsala was in there.
